page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E3.Flex.16-128 is a balanced, general-purpose virtual machine configuration designed for scalable enterprise workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance is powered by an AMD EPYC 7742 processor clocked at a base frequency of 2.25 GHz. It provides 16 dedicated physical cores and 32 virtual CPUs via simultaneous multithreading, along with 128.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio at 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware resource provisioning for this instance excludes local storage disks and discrete GPUs, meaning persistent file systems and databases must rely entirely on remote network-attached block volumes. The instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address for external network access. By using dedicated AMD EPYC cores without shared-core throttling, VM.Standard.E3.Flex.16-128 delivers predictable compute throughput suited for enterprise applications, application servers, mid-tier relational databases, continuous integration build nodes, and microservices orchestration.
